value.answer: Given her sibling's strep, this sore throat and fever could well be strep too - symptoms usually appear 2 to 5 days after exposure, and fever plus sore throat without cough or runny nose fits that pattern. A strep test isn't urgent; fine to book one at a regular visit. Keep her comfortable, push fluids, offer soft/cold foods if swallowing hurts.
value.triage: Call 811 if fever lasts past a couple days, she's drinking poorly, or you want help arranging a strep test. Go to the ER or call 911 now if she has trouble breathing, can't swallow her own saliva or is drooling, can't drink at all, gets a stiff neck with fever, or a rash that doesn't fade when pressed.
